ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services delivered strong Q1 FY '26 financial results with 18.7% YoY revenue growth and notable EBITDA margin expansion to 16.2%, largely propelled by acquisitions and cost optimization efforts, alongside strategic advancements in AI-driven solutions. However, underlying organic growth remains muted, with the Digital Experiences segment particularly challenged by the loss of significant clients to captive units and general client hesitation due to macro factors, indicating potential headwinds for sustained organic growth momentum despite the overall positive financial performance.
